quickRanges.days7: Compact button label for the last seven days, keep it very short
quickRanges.days30: Compact button label for the last thirty days, keep it very short
quickRanges.days90: Compact button label for the last ninety days, keep it very short

report.projects: Heading of the per-project breakdown table
report.agents: Heading of the per-agent breakdown table
report.providers: Heading of the per-provider breakdown table
report.models: Heading of the per-model breakdown table

cost.local: The model ran on this computer, so there is nothing to bill
cost.plan: The request was covered by a subscription plan, not billed per token

labels.mixed: The rows behind this value span more than one provider, model or billing mode
labels.generalProject: Usage that belongs to no project
labels.runtimeAcp: Command line coding agents connected over ACP

billing.api: Billed per token against an API key
billing.local: Ran on this computer, nothing is billed
billing.mixed: More than one billing mode in the same row

scope.child: A run started by another agent rather than by the user
scope.helper: A short internal model call, such as naming a chat

breakdown.name: Column header for the project, agent, provider or model name

heatmap.less: Legend end meaning the lowest token activity
heatmap.more: Legend end meaning the highest token activity

trend.day: Table column header for the calendar day
